Subject: SI-OC-0006 Rack optical cable assembly — request for information (SUP-06)

Dear Stane International team,

Thank you for your qualification packet for the Rack optical cable assembly, part number SI-OC-0006, Revision A. To complete our review, please send the following:

1. 8.subtier_certs — Certificates for your critical sub-tier suppliers: copies of the current quality-system certificates you hold on file for Wakanda Design Group (certificate number, standard, scope and expiry date). Your subtier document §1.2 says registrations are retained but includes none.
2. 9.second_source — Second qualified source: the name of the alternate manufacturer qualified to supply this part and the record of its qualification (for example an approval or PPAP record). Your cover letter §1.1 states an alternate is qualified but gives no details.

Please reply with the documents or tell us when we can expect them.

Regards,
Stark Industries Supplier Quality — Pepper Potts

audit_plan.question: Cover letter §1.1 claims a qualified alternate manufacturer for SI-OC-0006. On site, ask who it is and review its qualification record for this part number and revision, including the approval date and who approved it.

Subtier §1.2 claims current registrations are kept for critical outside suppliers. Pull the certificate on file for Wakanda Design Group and check that it is current, its scope covers the supplied item, and it is linked to the supplier record.
